 Student loans are changing. Do you know the real cost of college?
 Emily Burris Wed, November 18, 2026 at 3:37 PM CST 1 min read PORTLAND, Ore. ( KOIN ) — The federal government is changing rules for student loans. From new provisions around limits to changing options for repayment, there's a lot for borrowers to know. 
 Clay Cooper, Wealth Management Advisor at Clearview Financial Partners under Northwestern Mutual, joined AM Extra for a Wallet Wednesday discussion about what families need to know, before they decide on their child's higher education.
